name: scroll-unroll
title: Scroll Unroll
description: A title unrolls like a scroll: a roller sweeps across, the letters rise in behind it, then it all rolls back up. Pure CSS keyframes.
author: yui540 <https://github.com/yui540>
docs:
Installed `ScrollUnroll`. Import it from `@/components/ui/scroll-unroll` and render `<ScrollUnroll>Title</ScrollUnroll>`.

It plays once on mount; change its `key` to play it again.
The keyframes live in the component file and React 19 hoists them into `<head>` once (`<style href precedence>`), so nothing is added to your global CSS. Colors come from the item's own variables (`--scroll-unroll-surface`, `--scroll-unroll-ink`, `--scroll-unroll-line`, `--scroll-unroll-roll`, `--scroll-unroll-roll-shade`, `--scroll-unroll-core`), with the upstream grays as fallbacks.

Reduced motion: opacity only. The line and the title fade in and out on the same timeline; the roll rests where it starts.
